title: U.S. Visa Interview Prep
description: Interview rehearsal pack. Skills are interview competencies; problems are officer-question scenarios graded on rubric. The tutor plays the consular officer, then coaches.

problems.prompt: The officer asks: "What is the purpose of your trip?" You are visiting your sister in Houston for three weeks. Answer in two or three sentences.

criteria: one clear purpose stated up front
specific detail: who, where, how long
no rambling or extra volunteered information

problems.prompt: F-1 case. The officer asks: "Why this university?" You are heading to an MSc in Data Science at Ohio State. Answer as yourself.

criteria: names something specific about the program
links the degree to a career plan back home

problems.prompt: The officer asks: "Who is paying for your trip?" Your uncle is sponsoring you and his bank statement is in your file. Answer.

criteria: names the sponsor and the relationship precisely
consistent with what the documents would show
no hedging words like maybe or I think

problems.prompt: The officer asks: "What work do you do?" Describe your real job (or studies) in plain words, the way you actually would.

criteria: connects the role to life at home

problems.prompt: The officer asks the big one: "How do I know you will come back?" Answer with your strongest real ties.

criteria: names concrete ties: job, family, studies, property

problems.prompt: Rapid fire, 15 seconds: "Where will you stay?" Go.
